stepTitle: Which point is located at an angle of $$\frac{5\pi}{4}$$ radians? \n A unit circle centered on a coordinate plane with horizontal and vertical axes. Four points, labeled A, B, C, and D, are positioned on the circumference, one in each quadrant. Each point is located exactly halfway along the curved arc between the horizontal and vertical axes. Point A is in the first quadrant, Point B is in the second quadrant, Point C is in the third quadrant, and Point D is in the fourth quadrant. The points form the corners of a perfect square centered at the origin.
